notes: Send a Global Message gets a shelf. Touching a tier's WinPad is what pays, so the new page stands on the pad instead of running the obby: Easy 100, Medium 200, Hard 350, Nightmare 550, Insane 750, read from leaderstats.Cash. Tiers unlock in order and a locked pad bounces you back, so Auto touches each pad once from Easy up, keeps the highest one that paid, and farms that; three quiet attempts stop the loop instead of hammering a pad that moved. Pads are resolved by instance (Map.Obbies.<tier>.WinPad), not by coordinate, and the place is recognised under both 10164995980 and 118282960139128. tools/padlog.lua is the probe that produced those numbers.
